`positron-en.json` is OpenFreeMap's Positron style (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron, retrieved 2026-10-15; the style descends from CARTO's Positron for OpenMapTiles, BSD-3; data © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) with one change: every label layer's `text-field` is `name:en`, falling back to `name_en`, then the romanised `name:latin`, then `name`, so the map carries English names in the Latin alphabet. Tiles, fonts and sprites are fetched from tiles.openfreemap.org (free, no key, no limits, https://openfreemap.org); without them the page still draws the sub-regions and events. The build inlines this file into map.html so the page needs no fetch of its own.
